Definition
[Product CW structure]

↗ def:cell-complex \group CW Complexes

For CW complexes $X$ and $Y$, the product CW structure has cells $e^m_\alpha \times e^n_\beta $. Its CW topology can be finer than the product topology; the topologies agree if either factor has finitely many cells or both have countably many cells.
